lead: Investigate logical warp-per-node aggregation for independent training up_action updates on sufficiently large level spans, with original global entry preserved for small spans. Existing handwise action arithmetic has no CTA reduction/barrier. One prospective physical128-thread block could hold4independent32-thread logical node groups, preserving every per-hand action/reduction order and original node-list order. No implementation/threshold/source/compile/native work admitted.
first_gates: Inspect exact closed E007 launch widths and E081 warp/nodepacking source first; if this is an equivalent mapping/entry-subset/shape rescue, decline without code. Different labels alone are not novelty. Read original dependency/CFVslot/disjoint-action ownership proofs and every actual training launch/caller/continuation path.

Prove that each hand is mapped once, different node groups cannot race on parent/child CFV or regret/strategy ranges, partially active groups do not violate barriers, and locks/roles/generic menus/empty counts remain exact. All CUDA source, host ABI, node order, precision and public stop/iteration semantics require review before any native admission.

If distinct, design a separate private packed entry and hardware-resource-derived occupancy eligibility while retaining byte-equivalent original entry/fallback; choose one formula before observations, not a threshold/count/shape sweep. Original small level behavior and existing supported entry shapes must remain. Disclose extra module/host/graph/resource costs; do not infer no tradeoffs from payload equality.

Require intended compiled mapping, unchanged original entry/other kernels, actual resource/capacity/graph/CPU costs and complete exact state with simultaneous heterogeneous logical groups before frozen same-quality complete-cycle timing. All1%/strictfixture/fresh16/broad/material/holdout/freshoriginal/application gates remain. No candidate admitted by this scope.
known_counterevidence: D179 padding/XOR bank-remapping and E022 unusedchunk trimming are closed/declined; no such hunks. E096 cache hints are closed and absent. Root/small-span latency can worsen when reducing threads/node, so preserve and verify original entry before any packed dispatch source; this is prospective design, not permission to rescue a failed packed form.
